# Catastrophic_Forgetting_Mitigation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
Techniques embedded in the network architecture or learning rule to prevent new knowledge from overwriting previously learned patterns during sequential task learning. Essential for continual learning in real-world deployments, ensuring that iNEST systems retain long-term functionality and adaptability.
